concerns.text: Task T029 introduces a 'Exploratory Mode' where the pipeline proceeds with PCA components for visualization if <2 components explain >90% variance. This directly contradicts Spec FR-005 and Edge Cases which mandate a hard HALT with 'Collinearity Unresolvable' error under these exact conditions. The task relaxes a mandatory failure constraint into a conditional warning/proceed path.

Task T032 mandates sweeping 'Outcome definitions: {Change Score, Residual, Raw Post}'. While the Plan (Phase 4) mentions this, the Spec FR-010 and SC-006 strictly define the sensitivity analysis scope as only 'motion threshold' and 'p-value'. Adding 'Outcome definitions' to the mandatory sweep without a corresponding FR/SC update constitutes scope creep and a semantic relaxation of the defined success criteria (SC-006).

Task T031 implements the power analysis logic and JSON output but lacks an explicit step to write the human-readable warning text ('WARNING: Underpowered...') into the final report. Spec SC-004 and Edge Cases explicitly require the system to 'write a warning... to the report log'. Relying on T031b to 'consume' the JSON risks the warning text being omitted if T031b only reads the JSON for data inclusion without generating the specific warning string required by the spec.

Task T044 explicitly mandates sweeping 'Outcome definitions' in the sensitivity analysis. As with T032, this expands the scope beyond Spec FR-010 and SC-006 which only authorize sweeping motion and p-value cutoffs. This creates a verification gap where the task requires output that the Success Criteria do not define, violating the constraint that tasks must not silently relax or expand requirements without spec alignment.
